title: Gothenburg Museum of Art
geometryBasis: Fitted the original building within the named museum’s current outline. Native straight terrace returns locate the front. The building’s historic footprint and original large stair arrangement are supported by the museum’s published history.
sectionBasis: Anders Wilhelm Karnell’s 1923 public-domain photograph shows the width of the terraced stone base, seven arches, medallions and shallow roof. The museum identifies the original materials as Gothenburg yellow brick and hewn natural stone.
limitations: The model focuses on the 1923 gallery and seven-arched entrance. The 1968 and 1996 additions, the Poseidon statue and independent neighbouring buildings are outside the model.
Historical rear transitions, exact wall slopes and small medallions are representative.
